item.title: The narrative-driven survival experience, Oppidum, is now available for the Switch
item.description: "Oppidum, the narrative-driven survival experience for 1 to 4 players developed by the Spanish studio EP Games, is now available on Nintendo Switch." - EP Games.

item.title: The chaotic multiplayer party game, Pritto Prisoner, is out now for PC and the Switch
item.description: "PinCool, in partnership with publisher Initiate Games, today announced that Pritto Prisoner is available now worldwide, launching just in time for Christmas on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam." - PinCool and Initiate Games.

item.title: The cross-platform RPG, Fallen Sword II, is coming to PC and mobile in Q3 2026
item.description: "Hunted Cow Games are today very happy and proud to announce that their cross-platform RPG, Fallen Sword II, is coming to PC and mobile in Q3 2026" - Hunted Cow Games.

item.title: The 2.5D multidirectional shooter Sub-Species has just been announced for PC
item.description: "Howling Hamster Entertainment are today very happy and excited to announce that their 2.5D multidirectional shooter Sub-Species, is now in development for PC." - Howling Hamster Entertainment.

item.title: UNBEATABLE Review - Jump Dash Roll
item.description: UNBEATABLE is a rhythm game with a plot. But does the gameplay make it sing? JDR loosens up its fingers for today's review.

item.title: How Screamers anime-inspired story avoids the usual tropes of racing games
item.description: In this interview, Milestone reveals to Traxion how Screamer is reimagining the racing game story mode. The integrated narrative is more than cutscenes, but in-race characters and customised vehicles to match each protagonist.

item.title: Quentin Tarantino and Fortnite: why Yuki's Revenge is pivotal to a new filmmaking era
item.description: Digging up lost Kill Bill content for Fortnite is a funny idea, but is Quentin Tarantino onto something with Yuki's Revenge?

item.title: Another Japanese City Opens its Own Game Within Fortnite
item.description: Fortnite's gradual transformation into a Metaverse has been attracting many institutions, including the Japanese city of Tamana.

item.title: Soulframe isn't ready for Nintendo Switch 2 yet, but could that change soon?
item.description: Digital Extremes' new Warframe follow-up Soulframe is already in great shape to be a hit on Switch 2, but you play it on your Steam Deck right now.

item.description: A mix of expected sequels and out-of-nowhere indie gems made 2025 a joy.
